title: What the Hyperdimensional Navigator is
description: The navigator treats knowledge as multi-dimensional: every relationship has a time coordinate, a causal status, a similarity strength, and dependency links. Users navigate by moving along any dimension — forward in time, up the causal chain, across similar concepts — and the navigator keeps the other dimensions visible as context.

title: Multi-dimensional relationship data model
description: A relationship is a record with coordinates: the connected concepts, the time interval it holds over, its causal role (cause, effect, correlate), similarity scores to neighboring relations, and dependency links to the systems it affects. Dimensions are optional but explicit — an undated relation says so rather than pretending.
